cause.description: validation (a failed check: the item goes back to ready and spends one of its retries), environment (parked held infrastructure, no attempt or retry spent) or other (the default: the classifier reads the error, and the work's failure fails the item); or the class itself (ADR 069 2b): work, or product, platform or infrastructure — a failure not the work's, which sends the item back to ready with nothing spent, the fourth held for a person
